notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
There have been several questions about running the game on a Steam Deck, and I'm happy too confirm this has been confirmed to work perfectly.

Many thanks to [i][b]Sandy White[/b][/i] for also confirming it's use - and how awesome it is to play on the handheld device!
